about: Migna's public record at this close: every company in the screened universe with its reading and its close, and every company we’ve found with what it takes to recompute its move: when it was published, its entry (the next session's open), the day's open and close, its lowest close since entry, our estimate and band on its find day, the end of its judging clock, and the S&P 500 (SPY) over the same window. Fingerprinted nightly (record_fingerprint.py).
basis: Prices: find_day_close, entry_price, day_open, day_close and low_close are the vendor's dividend-adjusted closes and opens as at this file's close (rescaled at each later ex-dividend date); the *_raw fields beside them are the prices as traded (split-adjusted, never rescaled for dividends), from the price store. move_pct is the price move on the adjusted levels. The S&P 500 levels are the index's closes.
